and returns only verified jobs. Nothing of the AWS results is stored.
WebSearchJobsIn.title: WebSearchJobsIn

post.description:
End test mode and start with real data. Deletes every team, Team Lead, member, candidate, resume, search, job,
assignment, notification and log entry. Keeps the Admin accounts, the settings and the job board index. It
works once: when test mode is off the call is refused. There is no undo.

409.description: Not in test mode, or a search is queued or running

get.description: The same answer as GET /api/users/{id}/dashboard: totals over the candidates assigned to this member today.

Jobs assigned to candidates, within the caller's scope (a member: the candidates assigned to them today).
`candidate_id` narrows to one candidate, `member_id` to the candidates of one responsible member.
Report of the caller's scope (Admin: organization, Team Lead: own team). Posting URLs are included for managers only.

Audited redirect to the posting. The destination is read from the stored job record only (nothing from the
request), must be a public http(s) address, and opening it is logged without changing the applied state.
The rules a new password has to meet, for the screens that ask for one before anyone is signed in.
The candidate's open assignments, each with its application system and whether a run can be started.

404.description: No such screenshot (or deleted by retention)

post.description:
Bring a Salesforce candidate (a Person Account) into the portal: details, mapped job-search profile and the
newest active resume file. Salesforce is only read. Already in the caller's scope: refreshed and returned (200).
In another team: 409 for a Team Lead, with no detail. A resume that cannot be taken over (wrong type, too
large, unreadable) does not stop the import: `sync.resume` says what happened.

200.description: The candidate was already in the portal and has been refreshed

404.description: No such Salesforce candidate (or not one this Team Lead may find)

409.description: Already in the portal, in a team the caller cannot see

503.description: Salesforce is not configured or not reachable

schema.title: Response List Candidate Consents Api Candidates  Candidate Id  Consents Get

delete.description: Deletes the current resume: its text and its file.

get.description: The current resume with its extracted text, or null when the candidate has none.

schema.title: Response Get Candidate Resume Api Candidates  Candidate Id  Resume Get

post.description:
A Team Lead or Admin uploads the candidate's resume (PDF, DOCX or TXT). The text is extracted for searching
and the file itself is kept, so the responsible member can download it when applying. It replaces the current one.

get.description:
The file that was uploaded, for exactly the people who may see the candidate. Always an attachment, with a
content type chosen by the server from the file's extension, so a browser never renders or interprets it.

200.description: The uploaded resume file, as an attachment

404.description: No candidate, no resume, or a resume uploaded before files were kept

post.description:
Read details, profile and resume again. A field changed in the portal since the last sync is kept, and a
resume uploaded in the portal is only replaced by a Salesforce file that is newer than it.

404.description: No such candidate, or the Salesforce record is gone

409.description: The candidate did not come from Salesforce

503.description: Salesforce is not configured or not reachable

get.description: Liveness for load balancers and Docker. Reveals no configuration.

The operational state of every applicant-tracking system and search provider, computed from what the job
index really holds (services/ats_health.py). Read-only; the index evidence is kept for a minute.

post.description: Read a posting page and return its details for review. Nothing is saved by this call.

get.description:
Person Accounts whose name, e-mail or phone contains `q`. Fewer than two characters: nothing, and Salesforce
is not asked. Under the setting `salesforce_team_lead_scope = own` a Team Lead only finds candidates whose
marketing team lead in Salesforce has the Team Lead's own sign-in e-mail address.
Whether Salesforce is set up and answering (checked at most once a minute). Never fails because of Salesforce.

schema.title: Response List Presets Api Search Presets Get

get.description: Server-Sent Events: a snapshot of the run whenever it changes, until it finishes.

post.description:
Create an account. Nobody ever chooses another person's password: the account is created in the
"invited" state and the invitation is returned, exactly as POST /api/invitations does (same rules:
a Team Lead can only add members to their own team).

get.description: What happened on the jobs of the candidates this member is responsible for today.
Totals over the candidates this member is responsible for today, with one row per candidate.

post.description: A manager creates a one-time password reset link for a user in their scope (used when e-mail is not configured).
